title: Home Weather Station
summary: Home weather station: BME280 temperature/humidity/pressure (C92489) on a 46x50 mm board with XIAO ESP32-C3, 0.96-inch OLED display, status LED (D10) and page button (D1). Readings show on the OLED (two pages, button flips) and on a Wi-Fi web page. Soft desk case 56x56x15.5 mm with display window, bu

doc.title: Home Weather Station
doc.summary: Home weather station: BME280 + OLED + Wi-Fi

requirements.text: show readings on OLED display, pages flipped by button
serve readings over Wi-Fi web page
status LED blinks on every reading

uses: on a living-room shelf powered from USB: readings on OLED and phone over Wi-Fi
in a bedroom at night: check temperature/humidity at a glance, flip display pages with button

options.name: Shelf block
options.look: small soft block standing on a shelf, OLED on lid, button below it
options.panel: OLED centred on lid, status LED left, page button right below display

options.name: Wall tile
options.look: flat tile on two screws at eye height, cable leaving at bottom
options.panel: OLED at top, LED under it, button beside it, sensor vent at bottom far from module

options.name: Fridge puck
options.look: round puck on magnets on a fridge
options.panel: round OLED window centre, LED ring around it, button at bottom of circle

concept.why: Shelf block keeps the OLED facing the room, fits the display plus button, and needs no mounting.

firmware.notes: XIAO ESP32-C3: Arduino core, install Adafruit SSD1306, GFX, BME280 libraries. Edit WIFI_SSID/PASS, flash via USB-C.

check.tool: g++ 14.2.0 compile, no link (arduino-esp32 3.x stubs, Seeed

U1_btn_reset: plunger 0.30 mm above the button, tongue 10 mm free, bending strain 1.32 % (PLA limit ~2 %)
SW1: plunger 0.30 mm above the button, tongue 10 mm free, bending strain 1.32 % (PLA limit ~2 %)
U2: sensor window 3.6 x 4.38 mm open
DS1: display window 22.34 x 11.46 mm open; held down onto its header by the lid rim (2.4 mm) at 4 of 4 sides
lid vs base overlap 0.000 mm3; 4 snap hooks, catch 0.28 mm
snap hooks bend 1.67 % going in (PLA ~2 %, PETG ~4 %); print in PETG for a lid that opens often
